title: Size of a vertex unfolding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ inputs. For each natural-number vertex $v$, define its unfolding size to be the number of entries in the list produced by unfolding $v$ in $C$, with bound $v+1$ and the initial flag set to true.
caveat: The unfolding operation is not defined in the supplied context, so its construction cannot be described more precisely.
